readme: Brand library options (plugin-settings@1): the keys in plugin.json settings.options, served from this plugin's config (server/__init__.py) through server/plugin_options.py, so REST, MCP, the CLI and voice read and set them like the Settings → Plugins → Brand library panel does.

settings.label: Opens on
settings.description: The library tab the screen opens on (logos, animated logos, icon packs, branding packages).

settings.label: Tile size
settings.description: How large the tiles in the grid are.

settings.label: Brand filter
settings.description: Show one brand only (AmberX, GizmoX); empty = every brand.
